segments.title: August
segments.text: Hello Bandra! August is The Amazing Race, version two. Friendship Day, Independence Day, and a studio-wide race that turns attendance into a sport. Half the city is on holiday. The other half is on our leaderboard.

segments.title: ₹25.5L
segments.text: So, the number. Our August target for Bandra is 25.5 lakh rupees. That's 12 per cent above last August. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 13 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 6.88 lakh, comebacks 4.59 lakh, and everything else 1.02 lakh. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 82 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 731 leads, 380 trials, and 82 buyers, with about 22 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.

Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 18.7 lakh rupees, which is 73 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Friends With Benefits (Strictly Fitness)
segments.text: First up, Friends With Benefits. Strictly fitness. Bring a friend who's never been, and they get two classes on us. If they join, you both get race tees, and you get bonus days and double points. The plan is 7 buyers at about 17,200, so 1.2 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Rookie Mistake (The Only Good One)
segments.text: Next, for newcomers, Rookie Mistake, the only good one. Two weeks unlimited at an intro price, plus a spot on the rookie leaderboard. The only rookie mistake is not starting. The plan is 15 buyers at about 16,200, so 2.43 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Medal Detector
segments.text: Then, for race finishers, the Medal Detector. Finish the race and your renewal finds gold. Six months at twenty per cent off plus a private, or three months at fifteen per cent off plus bonus days. The plan is 24 buyers at about 42,000, so 10.1 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: 6M ≈24% effective with private, inside the cap for 6M+ plans

segments.title: At the Stroke of the Midnight Hour
segments.text: And finally, on Independence Day, At the Stroke of the Midnight Hour. Annual memberships at twenty-five per cent off, for the fifteenth of August only, with a strictly limited count. When the world sleeps, our members renew. The plan is 3 buyers at about 1.65 lakh, so 4.94 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Friendship Day, and every friend gets two classes on us. Week two, Independence Day, and the midnight annual sale for one day only. Week three, the rookie leaderboard heats up, so celebrate newcomers by name. Week four, race finishers get their Medal Detector renewal.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's August at Bandra. 25.5 lakh rupees, four offers, and 82 buyers to welcome. On your marks. Get set. Sell.
